summary: Tested 4 features (backend + frontend at 390x844). Backend: 6/6 pytest passed (tests/test_bulk_quickreg_catchnotes.py, 1 real AI fish call). (1) Bulk Quick Reg: POST /api/crew-register/quick-bulk adds rows with status registered and quick_reg true. It skips a case-insensitive duplicate ('That email is already on your list'), a bad email ('Please enter a valid email address') and a missing name, each with a reason. 0 or 51 people gives 422 and no auth gives 401. UI: the preview parses comma, <email>, tab and email-only lines, and shows 'No email found' rows in red (rgb 153,27,27). The save button added 4 people and listed 2 skipped in bulk-quick-skipped. The new rows show the QUICK REG badge, with no page overflow. (2) Catch notes/weight: the API stores weight_kg 2.35 with weighed true and the note, both returned by /api/me/catches. The Ship's Log label has 'weighed 2.35 kg' and ends with 'Note: ...'. Out-of-range weight and a note over 300 characters give 422. UI offline queue: the note and weight inputs saved on blur and survived a reload. Identify sent them, and the report showed '62 cm (24.4 in) · 3.4 kg (7.5 lb), weighed' and 'Your note: ...'. (3) Catch of the Trip: one card per day. With 3 catches on one day (5.5 kg, 3.4 kg, and 200 cm with no weight), the 5.5 kg one was correctly picked with 'Biggest of 3 catches that day'. A stubbed navigator.share got a title and caption starting 'Catch of the Trip · Mon, Nov 9, 2026' and a file named ...-catch-of-the-trip.jpg. Tapping the photo opens catch-log-detail. The page scrollWidth is 390 and the strip scrolls on its own (532/346). (4) Zone defaults: a node unit test of zoneDefaultAreas passed (skips existing top-level names, F/D flags right, a rerun adds 0). A real 'Magically Place Colours' run gave the toast 'placed 11 colours and added 15 cupboards for those zones'. All 15 were saved with zone labels, Dry Food Locker F only, and they showed under the colour groups (Galley, Cockpit - 4, Forward cabin - 1). Fridge, Freezer, Pantry and Hanging Basket already existed, so they were skipped. A second run added nothing (no duplicates). FOUND: one layout bug (fixed) and one race bug (reported).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. App.css .field-input {width:100%; height:48px; font-size:16px} overrode Tailwind w-16, so the weight input took the full row and the note input shrank to about 26px wide (unusable at 390px). Changed the weight input to '!w-20 shrink-0'. Now note=224px, weight=80px. Note: h-9/text-xs are also overridden by .field-input (the inputs are 48px tall); that is harmless.

Race: type a note or weight on a queued photo, then tap the trash (fish-queue-remove-<id>) straight away. The input's blur calls updateCatch, which reads in one transaction and puts in a separate later one. That re-creates the item after dropCatch deleted it, so the photo comes back and survives a reload. Reproduced 1/1 (removing without editing works). Fix: do get+put inside a single readwrite transaction (store.get(id).onsuccess -> store.put), or skip the put when the item is gone.

There is no client-side max. A weight over 1500 kg (or over about 3307 lb) makes the backend return 422. identifyAll only drops the item on 400, so on 422 it toasts 'Your photos are still waiting' and breaks. The bad item then blocks the whole queue on every try. Validate on the client (0 < kg <= 1500), or treat 422 like 400 and show the reason.

The save button counts rows with no email ('Quick Reg 6' when one line has no email) even though they will be skipped. After a save with skipped rows, the button stays enabled with the same text, and pressing it again resubmits everyone, who then all show as duplicates. Exclude no-email rows from N and disable or hide the button once a result is shown.

action_items: Make fishQueue.updateCatch atomic (single readwrite tx) so removing a queued photo straight after editing its note or weight really removes it
Validate the queued weight on the client (kg <= 1500 / lb <= 3306) and handle a 422 from /api/ai/fish so a bad item doesn't block the queue
Bulk Quick Reg: exclude 'No email found' rows from the 'Quick Reg N' count and stop a double submit after the result is shown
critical_code_review_comments: App.css .field-input sets width/height/font-size with the same specificity as Tailwind utilities and loads later, so w-*/h-*/text-* utilities on .field-input do nothing anywhere in the app. Use ! modifiers or move .field-input into @layer components.

OverviewMap passes all swatches from the reply (auto-swatches replaces the whole set) to addZoneDefaults. That is correct now, but if a swatch is later dropped by a rerun, its cupboards keep that zone label.
Catch of the Trip groups by the browser's local calendar day (toLocaleDateString en-CA), so the grouping depends on the device timezone. That is fine for the user's own phone.
Existing unzoned cupboards with a default name (e.g. Fridge) are skipped and not given the Galley zone. This matches the spec but may surprise users.
